system.description: You gain a pool of dice called Unleash Dice. Whenever you mark a Stress or an Armor in order to help an ally, you can place a d6 on this card, adding to the dice pool. You can store a number of Unleash Dice equal to your Proficiency. When you make an attack roll or damage roll, you can spend any number of these Unleash Dice, rolling them and adding their result to the roll. At the end of each session, clear any unspent Unleash Dice and gain a Hope per die cleared.
